=== Knaves Short Deck with Bids ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, use a 20-card deck: A, K, Q, J and 10 of spades (S), clubs (C), diamonds (D) and hearts (H). Within a suit, cards rank A (high), K, Q, J, 10 (low). Everyone starts with a total of 0.

The game has exactly 36 rounds; each round is one trick. Rounds 1-6 form hand 1, rounds 7-12 hand 2, and so on up to rounds 31-36, hand 6. In hand h the dealer is seat ((h-1) mod 3)+1, and eldest, the seat to the dealer's left ((dealer mod 3)+1), leads the hand's first trick. So hand 1 is dealt by seat 1 and led by seat 2.

At the start of every hand the deck is reset to all 20 cards, hands and the discard pile are emptied, and every bid, tricks_taken and hand_score is set to 0. The deck is shuffled once; seats 1, 2 and 3 each get 6 cards, seen only by their owner. Card 19 is turned face up as the turned card and its suit is trumps; it is out of play. Card 20 goes face down, out of play, and is never revealed. The deck is then empty.

Right after the deal, all three seats bid at the same moment, a whole number from 0 to 6: the number of tricks you predict you will take this hand. All bids are then shown to everyone.

Each trick: the leader plays any card from their hand first; its suit is the led suit. Then seat (leader mod 3)+1 plays, then the remaining seat, each seeing the cards already played. If you hold any card of the led suit, you must play one of them (you are offered only those). If you hold none, you may play any card, including a trump. Played cards go to the discard pile and never return.

If any trump was played, the highest trump wins the trick; otherwise the highest card of the led suit wins. The winner leads the next trick of the hand. The winner adds 1 to tricks_taken and adds to hand_score 2, minus a penalty for each Jack among the three cards in the trick: JS 1, JC 2, JD 3, JH 4. A Jack is penalised even when it is a trump. A trick can therefore score less than zero (JH and JS together: 2-4-1 = -3).

After the sixth trick of a hand: each player whose tricks_taken equals their bid adds 5 to hand_score; a player who missed their bid, over or under, gets no bonus. Every player then adds hand_score to their total, and the totals are announced.

After round 36 the player with the highest total wins. Players tied for the highest total share the result (a draw).

[user]
=== Knaves Short Deck with Bids ===

Three players, seats 1, 2 and 3, use a 20-card deck: A, K, Q, J and 10 of spades (S), clubs (C), diamonds (D) and hearts (H). Within a suit, cards rank A (high), K, Q, J, 10 (low). Everyone starts with a total of 0.

The game has exactly 36 rounds; each round is one trick. Rounds 1-6 form hand 1, rounds 7-12 hand 2, and so on up to rounds 31-36, hand 6. In hand h the dealer is seat ((h-1) mod 3)+1, and eldest, the seat to the dealer's left ((dealer mod 3)+1), leads the hand's first trick. So hand 1 is dealt by seat 1 and led by seat 2.

At the start of every hand the deck is reset to all 20 cards, hands and the discard pile are emptied, and every bid, tricks_taken and hand_score is set to 0. The deck is shuffled once; seats 1, 2 and 3 each get 6 cards, seen only by their owner. Card 19 is turned face up as the turned card and its suit is trumps; it is out of play. Card 20 goes face down, out of play, and is never revealed. The deck is then empty.

Right after the deal, all three seats bid at the same moment, a whole number from 0 to 6: the number of tricks you predict you will take this hand. All bids are then shown to everyone.

Each trick: the leader plays any card from their hand first; its suit is the led suit. Then seat (leader mod 3)+1 plays, then the remaining seat, each seeing the cards already played. If you hold any card of the led suit, you must play one of them (you are offered only those). If you hold none, you may play any card, including a trump. Played cards go to the discard pile and never return.

If any trump was played, the highest trump wins the trick; otherwise the highest card of the led suit wins. The winner leads the next trick of the hand. The winner adds 1 to tricks_taken and adds to hand_score 2, minus a penalty for each Jack among the three cards in the trick: JS 1, JC 2, JD 3, JH 4. A Jack is penalised even when it is a trump. A trick can therefore score less than zero (JH and JS together: 2-4-1 = -3).

After the sixth trick of a hand: each player whose tricks_taken equals their bid adds 5 to hand_score; a player who missed their bid, over or under, gets no bonus. Every player then adds hand_score to their total, and the totals are announced.

After round 36 the player with the highest total wins. Players tied for the highest total share the result (a draw).

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 3. Seats are numbered 1 to 3.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

Each round runs in this order: reset and deal → your cards → the bid → the bids are shown → the lead → second to play → third to play → the trick is won → end of hand → next round → after the last trick.

Actions you may be asked for:
  the_bid      answer with one of the options you are given
  the_lead     answer with one of the options you are given
  second_to_play answer with one of the options you are given
  third_to_play answer with one of the options you are given

  GAME_START       This message. Sent once, before the first round.
  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.
                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.
  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,
                   in the format the message states.
  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

If you hold any card of the led suit, you must play one of them (you are offered only those). If you hold none, you may play any card, including a trump. Played cards go to the discard pile and never return.

If any trump was played, the highest trump wins the trick; otherwise the highest card of the led suit wins. The winner leads the next trick of the hand. The winner adds 1 to tricks_taken and adds to hand_score 2, minus a penalty for each Jack among the three cards in the trick: JS 1, JC 2, JD 3, JH 4. A Jack is penalised even when it is a trump.
